notes: 8 configurations from 4 manufacturers (Linde Kryotechnik, Bluefors/Cryomech, SHI Cryogenics, ORTEC/AMETEK), accessed 2026-11-01. Tavily, WebSearch and Lune quotas were exhausted, so manufacturer pages and PDFs were read directly (curl + pdftotext, built-in browser); Mirion (Cryo-Pulse 5 Plus) pages returned 403 or 'page moved'. Not included: SULTAN-type conductor facilities and ITER cryopump test stands (bespoke facilities, already in the catalog as expansion_a_epfl_sultan and expansion_a_iter_cryopump_test), pellet injectors and hydrogen-isotope distillation columns (no commercial datasheets), commercial cryopumps (the SHI Marathon CP datasheet gives pumping speeds and capacities but no cryopanel temperature or base pressure) and in-situ irradiation cryostats (no manufacturer page reachable). Absences use install=not_available with the complete standard-scope-of-supply / component list as the scope-defining quote (flags b=false, other shapes kind unknown); closed-cycle machines carry cryogen.type = []. Linde LR refrigerators are rated at 4.4 K, so their capacity is not stored under cooling_power.at_4200mK; temperature.range is lo = hi = 4.4 K. SHI marks its minimum temperatures 'for reference only'; for the SHI coolers temperature.range spans only the documented points (minimum and rating temperature), which may under-state the warm end because the capacity maps are graphical. The Cryomech AL600 sheet prints '430 W at 600 K' (typo for 60 K), not used. Conservative values: CH-160D3LT 90 W at 20 K (50 Hz); AL630/AL600 values are certified at 60 Hz and the configurations state a 60 Hz supply; MOBIUS hold time stored as the lower bound 7 days. HPGe configurations: crystal temperature and sample-space size are not published, so temperature.range/base and sample size are unknown (listed in not_found); all other passport keys are documented.
